first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid arsenic-free antimony binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -40 degrees C and the exposure time is 1 hours. An H2S generation of 4 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 60% or more are obtained. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO and Li7P3S11 material. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved sinterability and moisture stability and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 1 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more.

title: Method for forming a ceramic ion conductor film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a self-supporting ceramic ion conductor film produced by powder-to-film rolling and calendering. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The roll temperature is 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C and the sheet has a thickness of 20 micrometers after calendering. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4 and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The sheet is calendered to a thickness of 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers and laminated onto an electrode by roll-pressing without a drying step. The solvent-free sheet avoids the conductivity loss caused by polar solvents and improves the sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 180 degrees C, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The warm isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

assignee: Driostus Advanced Materials Technology CO., LTD.
title: Titanium-substituted lithium yttrium chloride ceramic ion conductor with orthorhombic structure for lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide ceramic ion conductor in which titanium is substituted for part of the yttrium in a lithium yttrium chloride framework. When z is 0.1, the conductivity is 3 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.2 V. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.6 micrometers to 6 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The composition further comprises a lithium metal halide in which the chloride anion sublattice is close-packed, and the halide is synthesized together with the main phase. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the lithium secondary battery. The halide phase is free of a LiCl secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li2ZrO3 and Li3InCl6 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Because the chloride framework is oxidation-resistant, the cycle life at 4.3 V is improved.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 470 degrees C, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. A 10 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The stack of 200 cells can be paired with a lithium battery for load leveling. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid having a soft-acid surface region and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a sulfide ion-conductive solid that retains 75% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 24 hours. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. The Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -40 degrees C and the exposure time is 24 hours. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid by stirring the raw materials in ethyl acetate at 25 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. The disclosure is applicable to argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A precursor of the Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, Li3PS4, and LLZO material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The ion-conductive solid obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 1 wt%. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the grain boundary resistance of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1 wt% or less.

title: Solvent-free free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder for lithium battery
abstract: A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet having a thickness of 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers and a porosity of 20% or less is provided. The roll temperature is 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C and the sheet has a thickness of 20 micrometers after calendering. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The resulting LATP and Li3PS4 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. The powder is synthesized by a liquid-phase route in which the raw materials are dissolved in a solvent, precipitated, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and beta-Li3PS4. The dry sheet is useful as a separator layer for roll-to-roll production, with improved cycle life and sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more.

title: P2O5-containing vitreous sulfide solid electrolyte and heat treatment method
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a beta-Li3PS4 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing P2O5. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The content of P2O5 is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 280 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.8 mS/cm or more. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the electrochemical window is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by uniaxial pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated therein. Crystallization is performed at 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which precipitates a thio-LISICON phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. The precipitated thio-LISICON phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm. The material comprises Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted Li6PS5X having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3PS4 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. An all-solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved cycle life and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 210 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 100%.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Ion-conductive solid slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer comprises ion-conductive solid particles, a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder, a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved, and a dispersant. The dried layer shows an ionic conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The slurry is applied onto a release film at a coating speed of 1 m/min to 10 m/min and dried at 100 degrees C to 140 degrees C in an oven. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4, and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. The slurry allows roll-to-roll production of the layer and improves the sheet formability of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid with low residual solvent for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ion-conductive solid that does not require long mechanical milling. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The disclosure is applicable to argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. The suspension has a solid concentration of 5 wt% to 20 wt% and is reacted at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 1 mS/cm or more. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the sinterability of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant aluminum stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The dopant aluminum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. Sintering at 1230 degrees C with a lithium excess of 15 mol% gives a relative density of 96% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. The disclosure is applicable to Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1030 degrees C to 1380 degrees C.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into an ion-conductive solid layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 200 nm. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 500 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ion-conductive solid to improve the cycle life of the solid-state battery. The inorganic layer is formed by sputtering to a thickness of 80 nm to 400 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 1 x 10^-6 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The suppression of filament penetration results in a longer cycle life and improved dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising silver-carbon composite (Ag-C) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.8% or more, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm.

title: Tin-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which hydrolysis is suppressed by tin substitution is provided. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The substitution amount is 3 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.1 mS/cm or more. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours is 65% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 25 cm3/g or less.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C.

assignee: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. Heat treatment at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm and a retention of 85% after humid exposure. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and LLZO material. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. A solid-state lithium battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a silicon substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for producing the same
abstract: A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte comprises a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12 and Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1230 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm and a relative density of 97%. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the high-voltage stability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.05 <= v <= 0.4, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 94% or more.

assignee: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Arsenic-free antimony-substituted sulfide ion-conductive solid with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The substitution amount is 8 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm or more. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li7P3S11, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 10 cm3/g or less. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. A solid-state battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite ion-conductive solid whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The Li6PS5Cl, Li3PS4, and LLZO material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a thio-LISICON phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing SiS2. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is thio-LISICON, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 40% to 75% by X-ray diffraction. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. A Li6PS5X phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 70:30, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the electrochemical window of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid for a lithium secondary battery has an argyrodite-type crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y). Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The ion-conductive solid may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. When fired at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 6.4 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.75.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and a solid-state battery including the sheet are described. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. With a binder content of 1 wt% and a roll temperature of 80 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 16% or less. The sheet is calendered to a thickness of 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers and laminated onto an electrode by roll-pressing without a drying step. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. A solid-state battery comprising the LLZO and LATP material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the solid-state battery. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. Because the fibril network holds the particles, the sheet is self-supporting and shows improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 16% or less, and wherein the free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a thio-LISICON phase
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 75:25 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. After heat treatment at 320 degrees C for 3 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 4 mS/cm. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7P3S11, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 24 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Method for forming a solid electrolyte film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: A solid electrolyte sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and an all-solid-state lithium battery including the sheet are described. The Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LLZO material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A precursor of the Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LLZO material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 100 degrees C to form a continuous film. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The roll temperature is 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C and the sheet has a thickness of 30 micrometers after calendering. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The method shortens the process and improves the interfacial resistance and sheet formability of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 10% or less, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and carboxymethyl cellulose binder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 200 cycles is also described. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive. The iron sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

assignee: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A solid electrolyte sheet of 30 micrometers is used as the separator. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li2ZrO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li2ZrO3 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. Suitable compositions include lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LiNbO3 and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The coating layer has an average thickness of 3 nm and a coverage of 90%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 50% relative to uncoated particles. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid that remains stable up to 4.8 V and a lithium battery with a high-voltage cathode are provided. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 4.8 V. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The oxide ion-conductive solid enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance for lithium battery
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 2 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. A sintering aid comprising Al2O3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. Sintering is performed at 1230 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The sintered body has a relative density of 94%, an average grain size of 2 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The all-solid-state lithium battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ion-conductive solid layer. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The method gives reproducible densification and improved high-voltage stability at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.01 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 86% or more.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a phosphate-based NASICON ion-conductive solid in which germanium substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The lithium secondary battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ion-conductive solid layer. With germanium substitution of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The positive electrode active material is LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ion-conductive solid. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the Li6PS5X type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The Li3InCl6, Li2ZrO3, and LiNbO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 480 degrees C. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1.1 <= a <= 1.9, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tungstate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium tungstate and to a method for producing the same. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. The Li2ZrO3 and Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 5 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 40%. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The coated particles are heat-treated at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved high-voltage stability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation
abstract: An air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte in which hydrolysis is suppressed by oxygen substitution is provided. After exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity retention is 70%. The Li6PS5X phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 40 cm3/g or less. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the grain boundary resistance and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an oxygen substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 500 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 500 MPa. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by thermal evaporation and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A method for forming a protective layer on lithium metal by thermal evaporation followed by solution coating of a polymer is described. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. The resulting LLZO material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. Also described is an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. After 300 cycles at 0.5 mA/cm2 the cell retains a Coulombic efficiency of 99.2% and no dendrite penetration is observed. The Li3N layer is amorphous and in direct contact with the metallic lithium, and the polymer layer faces the ion-conductive solid. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The lithiophilic interphase gives uniform lithium deposition and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.1 micrometers to 10 micrometers, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 75 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 30 nm to 1800 nm.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: A NASICON-type or perovskite-type oxide solid electrolyte with an oxidation limit of 4.5 V or more is described. The oxide particles have a core of the perovskite-type LLTO phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in tin. With tin substitution of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. In an embodiment the material is Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Part of the titanium in the perovskite-type LLTO phase is substituted by tin in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LATP, LLTO, and LLZO material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved sinterability at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Potentiometric sulfur dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum fluoride conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The protective layer improves the durability of the lanthanum fluoride sensor in an exhaust gas.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a high-voltage stable oxide ion conductor based on perovskite-type LLTO and a method for forming its oxidation-resistant surface. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. A capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The raw materials of the ion-conductive solid are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. Part of the titanium in the perovskite-type LLTO phase is substituted by zirconium in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the zirconium substitution and the surface region. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation
abstract: Provided is a sulfide solid electrolyte that retains 60% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 4 cm3/g or less. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 6 hours. The Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 4 cm3/g or less.
