After heat treatment at 280 degrees C for 3 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 1.2 mS/cm. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the cycle life is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 24 hours, and wherein the content of Li2O is 0.6 mol% to 12 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 190 degrees C to 380 degrees C.

title: Tin-substituted Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO solid electrolyte stable above 5.2 V
abstract: Provided is a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO solid electrolyte in which tin substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO material. The oxidation potential is 5.2 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the tin substitution and the surface region. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The widened electrochemical window improves the high-voltage stability of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.6 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li3YCl6 shell with high coverage and production method thereof
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based solid-state battery is described. The coating layer has an average thickness of 3 nm and a coverage of 95%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 40% relative to uncoated particles. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The Li2ZrO3 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

assignee: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiTaO3 shell with high coverage for lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose LiTaO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide solid electrolyte. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li2ZrO3 and LiNbO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 90%. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 60%. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the electrochemical window and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 70 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polycarbonate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for producing the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 96% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the LLTO and Li2ZrO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The grain size is 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and the relative density is 93% or more after sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C. The dopant aluminum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.1 to 0.45, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The disclosure is applicable to Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A precursor of the LLTO and Li2ZrO3 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.16 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 3 mol% to 23 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 0.2 micrometers to 12 micrometers.

title: Lithium nitride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 20 nm to 100 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF). The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. The polymer layer comprises polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and has a thickness of 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the all-solid-state battery. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 1 x 10^-5 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 99% after 100 cycles. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the ionic conductivity of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiNbO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 75% or more and an average thickness of 3.2 nm to 16 nm is provided. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ceramic ion conductor. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more.

title: Amperometric sulfur dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which sulfur dioxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The sensor with a response time of 5 seconds can monitor a lithium battery manufacturing line for sulfur dioxide. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for sulfur dioxide. The sensor shows a response time of 5 seconds to a step change of sulfur dioxide concentration at 300 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum fluoride conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li3BO3 shell with high coverage for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium borate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The LiNbO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved electrochemical window. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and nickel content of 60 mol% or more. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium niobate (LiNbO3). A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the electrochemical window and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 6 nm to 30 nm.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming a ceramic ion conductor sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. The fibrillated binder gives a flexible sheet and improved sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 40% or less, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 5 micrometers to 250 micrometers.

title: Lithium niobate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium niobate and to a method for producing the same. Specific examples are lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The average thickness of the coating is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The LiNbO3 and Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The high coverage of the coating results in improved electrochemical window at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more.

title: Self-supporting ion-conductive solid sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming an ion-conductive solid sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. In an embodiment the material is argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The tensile strength is 1.8 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Because the fibril network holds the particles, the sheet is self-supporting and shows improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 15 mol%. The total ionic conductivity is 0.56 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The dopant niobium occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 92% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the suppression of lithium filament growth in a solid-state cell by an additive that promotes uniform plating and stripping. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The LLZO and LiF material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and lithium fluoride (LiF). Lithium penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed because the nucleation is uniform and the current density is below the critical value. With the additive in an amount of 1 wt% and a stack pressure of 2 MPa, the Coulombic efficiency is 99%. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved cycle life and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the content of the zinc additive is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based lithium secondary battery is described. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 50%. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li2ZrO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tantalate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 90%. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the high-voltage stability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The cell may also be combined with a lithium battery in a hybrid power system operating at 500 to 650 degrees C. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The sulfur dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for sulfur dioxide. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects sulfur dioxide.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A glassy sulfide ion-conductive solid with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Crystallization is performed at 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 4 hours, which precipitates a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the solid-state lithium battery. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 4 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. A solid-state lithium battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved electrochemical window and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing the sulfide ion-conductive solid of claim 1, the method comprising: melting or mechanically amorphizing a mixture of Li2S, P2S5, and Li2O to obtain a vitreous precursor; quenching the precursor to obtain a glass; and heat-treating the glass at 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 4 hours to precipitate the crystal phase.

title: Gallium-doped garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body with high relative density
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant gallium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The LLZO material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Suitable compositions include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The total ionic conductivity is 0.28 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the sinterability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 0.5 micrometers to 30 micrometers.

title: Ion-conductive solid sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet comprises ion-conductive solid particles and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without a solvent. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The ion-conductive component may be Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). With a binder content of 3 wt% and a roll temperature of 80 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 20% or less. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid. The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved high-voltage stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.15 MPa or more, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 160 degrees C.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and zirconium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Described is a lithium yttrium bromide ion-conductive solid prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. In the monoclinic structure, yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed bromide sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The composition forms a shell on the cathode particles that suppresses the space-charge layer, so that the halide serves as the coating layer. The halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.3 V versus Li/Li+. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.8 V or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium niobium tantalum oxide coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction for lithium battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 60 mol% or more of the transition metals. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The average thickness of the coating is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C. In an embodiment the material is lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li3InCl6. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobium tantalum oxide, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure provides a Li6PS5X solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li7P3S11. The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state battery. A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 500 degrees C. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The capacitor rated at 10 V may be used in a charging circuit for a lithium ion battery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

assignee: Qilunhe New Energy Technology CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The solid electrolyte may comprise beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li7P3S11. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. The oxygen content of 4 mol% to 16 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 20 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 2.2 mS/cm or more. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved grain boundary resistance and sinterability and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours is 80% or more.

assignee: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LDT.
title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 100 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The roll pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium cobalt oxide, and a conductive agent. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises iron sulfide impregnated in ketjen black and a carbon coating on the composite. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A lithium-sulfur battery with the iron sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery comprising the cathode mixture, a sulfide solid electrolyte layer, and a lithium indium negative electrode is also provided. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 8 mol%. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the grain boundary resistance. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The sintered body has a relative density of 92%, an average grain size of 5 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The method gives reproducible densification and improved grain boundary resistance at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 5 mol% to 13 mol%, and wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6.

title: Lithium metal halide ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6 for lithium battery
abstract: A halide ceramic ion conductor comprises a monoclinic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6. When z is 0.4, the conductivity is 3 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.2 V. The material comprises Li3InCl6, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. A solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li3InCl6. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.8, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 470 degrees C, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 5 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. Specific examples are Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers. The mother powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers, and the sintered body has a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. Sintering is performed at 1250 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The method gives reproducible densification and improved grain boundary resistance at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 94% or more, and wherein 0.15 <= v <= 0.5.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Lithium tungstate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li2WO4 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The coating layer has an average thickness of 10 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 40% relative to uncoated particles. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li3YCl6, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 70 mol% or more of the transition metals. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li3YCl6. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A solid-state lithium battery using the coated active material shows improved dendrite suppression and ionic conductivity and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and a tin-rich surface region is described. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The tin substitution amount is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 550 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.1 mS/cm or more. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the grain boundary resistance are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 24 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a tin substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A solid electrolyte sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and a lithium secondary battery including the sheet are described. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved interfacial resistance. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 120 degrees C to form a continuous film. A sheet of 20 micrometers has an areal resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less at 25 degrees C. The solvent-free sheet avoids the conductivity loss caused by polar solvents and improves the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.6 MPa or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder for lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in ethyl acetate to give a sulfide ion-conductive solid precursor. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the all-solid-state battery. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The ion-conductive solid obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 0.2 wt%. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 3.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less.

title: Titanium-substituted lithium scandium bromide ceramic ion conductor with monoclinic structure and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed bromide anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The oxidation stability limit is 4.3 V or more and the conductivity is 1.05 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, ScBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.15 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The halide ceramic ion conductor is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the grain boundary resistance and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.6, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or thio-LISICON phase precipitates uniformly. A halogen-rich argyrodite-type with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The content of LiI is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 280 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.8 mS/cm or more. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed between the positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer, wherein the ion-conductive solid layer is formed by the method of claim 1.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The active material lithium sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery comprising the cathode mixture, a sulfide solid electrolyte layer, and a lithium indium negative electrode is also provided. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The ion-conductive solid shows an ionic conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 20 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -20 degrees C and the exposure time is 1 hours. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours is 75% or more.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the sulfur cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 800 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing sulfur with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the sulfur into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

assignee: Qilunhe New Energy Technology CO., LTD.
title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described.
