first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

assignee: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by atomic layer deposition and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a ceramic ion conductor layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. The low electronic conductivity of the LLZO, Li3PS4, and LiF material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The Al2O3 layer of 200 nm lowers the interfacial resistance to 20 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium metal battery using the protective layer shows improved ionic conductivity and Coulombic efficiency.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition (Al2O3) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 150 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.8% or more.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using an indium-containing additive layer
abstract: Described is a method of operating a solid-state lithium cell under a stack pressure of 10 MPa to 40 MPa with an indium additive. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The critical current density is 0.7 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 150 cycles or more. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The argyrodite phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. The indium additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. A stack pressure of 10 MPa to 40 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 60 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.8% or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: An ion-conductive solid comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.03, and the room-temperature conductivity is 4.2 mS/cm. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1.2 <= a <= 1.6, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.55.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a solid electrolyte of high conductivity. In a solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The precipitated beta-Li3PS4 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 4 mS/cm. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 280 degrees C. Suitable compositions include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The solid electrolyte shows improved ionic conductivity compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising molybdenum disulfide and carbon nanotubes and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, carbon nanotubes, and polyacrylic acid is described. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 85% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery comprising the cathode mixture, a sulfide solid electrolyte layer, and a lithium indium negative electrode is also provided. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: LiI-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. The Li7P3S11 and LGPS composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 260 degrees C. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The glass phase contains LiI in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.2 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. A solid-state battery comprising the Li7P3S11 and LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the cycle life of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of LiI is 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 170 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Lithium metal halide ion-conductive solid represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6 and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a halide ion-conductive solid in which titanium is substituted for part of the yttrium in a lithium yttrium bromide framework. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, YBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.1 to 0.35. The ion-conductive solid may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The halide ion-conductive solid is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.6, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more.

title: Amperometric carbon dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which carbon dioxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The sensor with a response time of 20 seconds can monitor a lithium battery manufacturing line for carbon dioxide. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of carbon dioxide.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ceramic ion conductor having a cubic argyrodite structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 6 mS/cm. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing the sulfide ceramic ion conductor of claim 1, the method comprising: mixing Li2S, P2S5, LiCl, and LiI at a molar ratio corresponding to the composition to obtain a precursor mixture; mechanically milling the precursor mixture; and firing the milled mixture at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an inert gas atmosphere.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: A garnet solid electrolyte sintered body having an average grain size of 8 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. Suitable compositions include Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The sintered body has a relative density of 92%, an average grain size of 8 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLTO, LATP, and Li2ZrO3 material. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. The material comprises Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. The method gives reproducible densification and improved high-voltage stability at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.42 mS/cm or more.

assignee: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The roll pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with low residual solvent
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from ethyl acetate, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state lithium battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers. The resulting Li6PS5Cl, LLZO, and Li3PS4 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 4 wt% to 16 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li3InCl6 shell with high coverage and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li3InCl6 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li3InCl6. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6) and has an average thickness of 3.2 nm to 16 nm and a coverage of 80% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium indium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LiNbO3 and Li3InCl6 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 50% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The lithium indium chloride shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 80% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm.

title: Lithium niobate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium niobate and to a method for producing the same. Specific examples are lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The average thickness of the coating is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The LiNbO3 and Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The high coverage of the coating results in improved electrochemical window at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.

A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The ceramic ion conductor can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. An ionic conductivity of 3.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 1.1 to 1.5. The ceramic ion conductor provides improved ionic conductivity and electrochemical window compared with a single-halogen argyrodite-type of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 330 degrees C to 580 degrees C, and wherein 0.9 <= a <= 1.7.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 100 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Lithium zirconate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery for lithium battery
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based solid-state battery is described. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The coating layer has an average thickness of 10 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 30% relative to uncoated particles. The ion-conductive component may be Li3InCl6 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved interfacial resistance. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the solid electrolyte is improved. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium zirconate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm.
